description:
In this city where it’s almost always rainy or overcast, there’s a man who dresses entirely in black, always carries an umbrella and wears sunglasses, and has sharp, pointed fangs. One day, he blatantly starts following me around.

*“You smell delicious.”*

All my senses are telling me the same thing. The guy who lives next door is seriously suspicious!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/strange_nb/), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/suspicious_neighborhood)

**Official Translations:**
